definition_zh: 用于离散三维连续体的有限元单元。
usage_overview: 实体单元用于将土体、轮对等三维连续体离散为有限元模型，以描述其空间变形，服务于车辆—轨道相互作用中近场土体响应及轮对柔性的分析。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Three sleeper element types, namely the rigid-body, extensible Euler-Bernoulli beam and solid element are used respectively in the track system modelling with detail mathematical formulations presented.
The ballast track system consists of the rail modelled by Timoshenko beams and the sleepers modelled by the rigid body, the elastic beam such as Bernoulli-Euler beam and the solid element.

In this work the rail pad is modeled as a spring-dashpot element, and the railway ballast is modeled as mass-spring-damper element; for the other bodies, the rail and the subgrade are modeled as Timoshenko (or Bernoulli-Euler) beam-columns and solid element respectively, as shown in Fig. 2 .
In the modelling process, the solid element is applied to model the sleeper.
